mentions.name: Gemini TTS AI radio station
mentions.description: An automated AI radio station tool that uses Gemini TTS multi-speaker voices for spoken segments over a soundtrack sourced from a Suno playlist that the tool downloads at startup. It plays 3-5 songs before a break in which it calls out channel donators or picks a random topic, generates the script with an LLM, and broadcasts the output as a wrapper around FFMPEG streaming to SRT or RTMP.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm actually building this exact thing right now.  Using Gemini TTS with its multi-speaker capabilities.  Soundtrack comes from a Suno Playlist which the tool will download the entire playlist at the start.

Plays 3-5 songs prior to a "break", where the logic will call out channel donators vs pick a random topic to discuss, then use an LLM to generate the script before sending to gemini.

In the end; its really just a wrapper around FFMPEG broadcasting to an SRT or RTMP stream.
